about: The sources of this project's subject matter (robot kinematics: frames, rotations, DH chains, Jacobians, inverse kinematics, the ABB IRB 120), apart from the design rules' bibliography, which keeps the design principles.

entries.title: Industrierobotik / Industrial Robotics (IRB), lecture slides, chapters 01 Introduction, 02 Mathematische Beschreibung der Kinematik von Robotern, 03 Vorwärtskinematik, 04 Geschwindigkeitskinematik, 05 Inverse Kinematik
entries.venue: Lecture slides, FH Technikum Wien, winter term 2020 (WS20), based on slides by M. Aburaia. Author, course and term from the title slide of chapter 1 and every slide's footer
entries.backs: Every equation of the labs, by chapter and PDF page, and the worked results used as practice questions: ch. 1, pp. 38–39 (Grübler); ch. 2, pp. 16, 34, 35, 38, 46, 48, 52, 59; ch. 3, pp. 3 and 26; ch. 5, pp. 8, 10, 19, 20.

entries.title: Product specification IRB 120, 3HAC035960-001, revision U
entries.backs: The IRB 120's dimensions (p. 12), its working-range table of wrist-centre positions (p. 31), its axis ranges (p. 32), its handling capacity of 3 kg and reach of 0.58 m (p. 11).

entries.title: Modulating the ABB IRB 120 for milling tasks: forward_kinematics(spyder).py, forward_kinematics(jupyter).ipynb and the report Baghdadi Irb120 report.pptx
entries.venue: Student project, Industrierobotik, FH Technikum Wien, 2020 (the user's own work, in the course folder's Presentation-Baghdadi)
entries.backs: The seven-row DH table of the IRB 120 (report slide 4, the script's subs), the printed home pose T = [0 0 1 374; 0 −1 0 0; 1 0 0 630] (notebook cell 1), and the Python style of the code panels.

entries.title: setFixedTransform, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: setFixedTransform(jnt,dhparams,'dh') with dhparams ordered [a alpha d theta]; theta ignored for revolute joints, d for prismatic ones; the Puma560 example building a robot body by body with rigidBody, rigidBodyJoint and addBody.

entries.title: rigidBodyTree, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: rigidBodyTree('DataFormat','row') as in the page's Dynamics example; addBody(robot,body,parentname) with 'base' for the first body; showdetails.

entries.title: getTransform, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: getTransform(robot,configuration,bodyname) returns the 4 × 4 transform from the body's frame to the base.

entries.title: geometricJacobian, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: geometricJacobian(robot,configuration,endeffector): 6 × n, angular velocity in rows 1–3, linear in rows 4–6; a vector configuration needs DataFormat 'row' or 'column'.

entries.title: inverseKinematics, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: ik = inverseKinematics('RigidBodyTree',robot); [configSol,solInfo] = ik(endeffector,pose,weights,initialguess); the first three weights are orientation, the last three position.

entries.title: homeConfiguration, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: homeConfiguration(robot) returns a vector of joint positions when DataFormat is 'row'.

entries.title: trvec2tform, Robotics System Toolbox reference page
entries.backs: trvec2tform([x y z]) gives a 4 × 4 transform with identity rotation. Read but not used in the panels; the rotz page (robotics/ref/rotz.html) answered 404 on 7 Nov 2026, so the panels write rotations by hand.
